title: PowerToys Monaco Preview Handler displays UTF-16LE .reg files with NUL characters
author: Jordi-PAPA

status.label: Actionable encoding defect
status.detail: The reporter supplied a sample, workaround, latest-version confirmation, and a narrow Monaco encoding path.

next_action.label: Complete encoding design
next_action.reason: Specify the decoded-text-to-WebView encoding contract and regression tests before approval.

judgment.rationale: The issue is fully reproducible on the latest stable version and source inspection identifies a concrete re-encoding boundary suitable for focused design and tests.
evidence: The attached UTF-16LE .reg sample displays NUL markers in Monaco but displays correctly through the Windows text preview handler.
The reporter manually updated to 0.101.2362.0 and confirmed the problem still reproduces.
MonacoPreviewHandler decodes with UtfUnknown, then base64-encodes the resulting text using the detected source encoding before injecting it into the WebView.
judgment.recommended_action: Develop an implementation-grade design that sends normalized decoded text to Monaco and adds UTF-16LE regression coverage.

issue_context.summary: Monaco correctly receives a UTF-16LE Registry file but renders each zero byte as a visible NUL marker instead of normal decoded text.
known_information: The issue includes a minimal .reg reproduction archive and a separate workaround archive.
UTF-8 content renders correctly, and disabling Monaco lets the built-in Windows handler render the UTF-16LE file correctly.
The current handler detects an encoding, reads text through StreamReader, and then converts that text back to bytes with the original encoding for base64 transport.
inferences: The WebView transport may expect UTF-8 or character text while receiving UTF-16LE bytes, which would explain alternating NUL markers.
The encoding detector itself may be working; the defect may occur after successful decoding.
issue_context.analysis: The reporter already closed the version and reproduction gaps. The source path offers a focused hypothesis that can be validated with unit tests, so another information request would delay an actionable fix.
initial_investigation: Inspected previewpane/MonacoPreviewHandler/MonacoPreviewHandlerControl.cs around charset detection, StreamReader decoding, and base64 generation.
Verified the issue's latest-stable retest and attached sample evidence.

information_gaps.information: The exact JavaScript decoding contract for the PT_CODE payload
information_gaps.why_needed: It determines whether the handler should always encode UTF-8 bytes or inject decoded Unicode through another safe transport.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Trace the Monaco index template payload decode and add round-trip tests for UTF-8, UTF-16LE with BOM, and UTF-16BE.
